CREATE TABLE device_type_brand ( type_code VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL, brand_code VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT pk_device_type_brand PRIMARY KEY (type_code, brand_code), CONSTRAINT fk_type_code_to_device_type_brand FOREIGN KEY (type_code) REFERENCES device_type (code), CONSTRAINT fk_brand_code_to_device_type_brand FOREIGN KEY (brand_code) REFERENCES device_brand (code) );
